title: PotentialSuite
author: PotentialBreaks
summary: Twelve plugins for sample-based beatmaking that share one look (Print Plate, Night Rack or Colour Block): samplers for breaks and songs, a 12-bit vintage drum sampler, a drum-kit builder, a record digger, and effects for vinyl age, drum punch, tape heat, noise, grit and bleed, with matching FX chains. Install all, or pick any one.
